text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
—Anyway, I hate that menu! If it's not the 
one I came up with, I definitely! Hate it!

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
...Sorry, but we can't cater to your 
selfishness. If we pick training based on 
likes and dislikes—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Ah! Sweep-san!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...Umm, everyone, that's not it! It might 
sound selfish, but really—!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph! What are you doing here anyway? 
You don't want to listen to a kid's 
selfishness either, right!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I don't think that at all. Not even once. 
...Because to me—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I think it's super, super wonderful! That 
side of you, Sweep-san!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...There was a time when I overworked 
myself over races. Back then—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
You invited me to Kyoto, didn't you? I 
know it wasn't just a coincidence.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
At the shrine training, I managed to 
succeed after several tries... And that 
helped me look on the bright side, 
thinking, "I'll just keep challenging 
until I win races too!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Giving up on waiting in line and eating 
croquettes instead was because you noticed 
my stomach rumbling, right!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Re-choosing the power stones was the same! 
You were looking out for me because I held 
back while choosing around others, right?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
This time is just like that too. The 
reason you rejected the menu everyone made 
was that some girls would struggle due to 
their distance aptitudes, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...I just didn't want to lose practice 
partners for my "Racing Magic". Running 
against people who aren't going all out is 
just boring!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I see... But when I told everyone that, 
they said, "Let's rethink the menu."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...So you see. To me, your words aren't a 
child's selfishness at all, Sweep-san.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
They're wonderful magic words that make 
everyone happier than before!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...Fufun♪ Of course they are! After all, 
I'm the genius magical girl, Sweep Tosho!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
All right, it's decided! ...Seeing as you 
have the talent to see through magic, I'll 
teach you a "certain spell"♪

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Found them! I found them, Sweep-san!! Ten 
four-leaf clovers!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Now preparations for the "Reconciliation 
Magic" are complete! Good job, Kitasan! 
Good girl, good girl♪

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ! Yeah! Ehehe...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! I picked some pretty flowers 
too! Can we use these as well? Also, if 
there's anything else I can help with, 
just say the word!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
That's true! In that case, give me a 
piggyback ride back to the dorms! I've got 
to hurry and prepare my drying magic♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Did she get dragged into something 
again? If so, I'd like to call out to her, 
but...
choice_data_list: Would you like me to help out too?

Um, don't forget the price for granting a 
wish, okay?

Um, don't forget the price for granting a 
wish, okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Did she get dragged into something 
again? If so, I'd like to call out to her, 
but...
choice_data_list: Would you like me to help out too?

Um, don't forget the price for granting a 
wish, okay?

Um, don't forget the price for granting a 
wish, okay?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you too? Nice thought, but no thank 
you today!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Reconciliation Magic" requires 
"friendship" as its key, after all. 
Kitasan is way better suited for the job!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
! ...Ehehe! Sweep-san, my back is ready 
whenever you are!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!? ...Wait, Sweep-san, you're way too 
light! Are you eating properly?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I cast a featherlight spell just for you! 
Come on, full speed ahead!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
What's with you, butting in all of a 
sudden? ...Well, it's true that a wish 
requires a price.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Grumbleeee...)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
S-Sorry! That was my stomach! T-To tell 
the truth, I've been starving for a while 
now...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Pfft! ...Then the price will be sweets! I 
have a special stash, so let's hurry back!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
A special stash!? Then let's hurry home! 
—"Rescue Kitasan Express," rolling out!
